description: This file is a shell script that acts as a web interface for Git repositories, allowing starting, stopping, and restarting a web server to serve Git web pages. It contains configuration and setup scripts for various web servers like lighttpd, Apache, WEBrick, Mongoose, Plackup, and Python, to serve gitweb.cgi. The script manages server configuration, process control, and environment set up for running a Git web interface browser accessible over the network.

methods.name: resolve_full_httpd
methods.description: Resolves the full path of the httpd command based on the configuration and environment.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts the configured web server for serving gitweb.

methods.name: stop_httpd
methods.description: Stops the running web server instance.

methods.name: httpd_is_ready
methods.description: Waits for the web server to become responsive on the configured port.

methods.name: gitweb_conf
methods.description: Creates the main configuration for the web server environment.

methods.name: configure_httpd
methods.description: Configures the web server based on the specified server type.
